correctness.rationale: Positive diagonal congruence corresponds to diagonal Loewner sandwich W<=A<=κW; averaging W over the leaf-permuting automorphism group keeps inequalities valid and produces an invariant optimum without assuming an optimizer is invariant. On invariant D(q), spectra are 1-s (multiplicity k), 1+s (k-1) and the two eigenvalues of [[q,sqrt(2kq)t],[sqrt(2kq)t,1+s]]. The upper block eigenvalue strictly increases, while λ+/λ- is minimized uniquely at q=1+s. The lower active level switches where λ-=1-s, at q=s(1-s)/(s-θ); comparing its position to 1+s gives θ_c=2s²/(1+s). Exact branch formulas and Jacobi locus then follow. Independently recomputed symmetric matrix eigenvalues and one-dimensional minimizers in 27 interior configurations; finite optimization was numerical corroboration, not proof of global unrestricted optimality.
